notes: timeDelayAttack shifts sendTime AND rcvTime by the same delay (attackGenerator.py:199-200), so delay_ms carries no signal for that attack by construction
features never read the ground-truth files or the attacker label; the eval-only diagnostic label is stored outside X
fitted_transforms: none: every feature is a deterministic function of the message and the receiver's earlier messages; any scaler added later must be fitted on Train only

features.name: spd
features.calculation: reported speed
features.missing: never missing

features.name: acl
features.calculation: reported acceleration
features.missing: never missing

features.name: dist_tx_rx_m
features.calculation: 2-D distance between reported sender position and receiver's own position
features.missing: never missing

features.name: abs_rel_speed
features.calculation: |reported speed - receiver's own speed|
features.missing: never missing

features.name: heading_diff_rx_deg
features.calculation: absolute angular difference of the two headings
features.missing: never missing

features.name: delay_ms
features.calculation: rcvTime - sendTime
features.missing: never missing

features.name: has_prev
features.calculation: 1 if the receiver got an earlier message from this pseudonym, else 0
features.missing: never missing

features.name: n_prev
features.calculation: number of earlier messages from this pseudonym at this receiver
features.missing: never missing

features.name: rate_1s
features.calculation: earlier messages from this pseudonym received within the last 1 s
features.missing: never missing (0 without history)

features.name: dt_send_s
features.calculation: sendTime - previous sendTime of this pseudonym (negative = out of order)
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0)

features.name: dt_rcv_s
features.calculation: rcvTime - previous rcvTime of this pseudonym
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0)

features.name: dpos_m
features.calculation: 2-D distance to the previous reported position
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0)

features.name: implied_speed
features.calculation: dpos_m / dt_send_s
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0); also NaN when dt_send_s <= 0

features.name: speed_residual
features.calculation: |implied_speed - mean(spd, previous spd)|
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0); also NaN when dt_send_s <= 0

features.name: dspd
features.calculation: spd - previous spd
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0)

features.name: implied_acl
features.calculation: dspd / dt_send_s
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0); also NaN when dt_send_s <= 0

features.name: acl_residual
features.calculation: |implied_acl - mean(acl, previous acl)|
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0); also NaN when dt_send_s <= 0

features.name: dhed_deg
features.calculation: absolute angular change of heading since the previous message
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0)

features.name: yaw_rate_dps
features.calculation: dhed_deg / dt_send_s
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0); also NaN when dt_send_s <= 0

features.name: bearing_residual_deg
features.calculation: angle between direction of travel (north = 0, clockwise) and reported heading
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0); also NaN when dpos_m < 1 m

features.name: pos_pred_error_m
features.calculation: distance between reported position and dead-reckoned position (previous position + previous spd * dt along previous heading)
features.missing: NaN when the receiver has no earlier message from this pseudonym (has_prev = 0)

features.name: speed_residual_mean5
features.calculation: mean speed_residual over the last 5 messages of this pseudonym (current included)
features.missing: NaN when none of them has a speed_residual

features.name: pos_pred_error_max5
features.calculation: max pos_pred_error_m over the last 5 messages (current included)
features.missing: NaN when none of them has a pos_pred_error_m

features.name: dt_send_min5
features.calculation: min dt_send_s over the last 5 messages (current included)
features.missing: NaN when none of them has a dt_send_s

excluded.ground-truth files: ground truth only; used for mapping verification, never for features
excluded.sender_id: true vehicle identity; a receiver only sees the pseudonym
excluded.sender_alias: pseudonym; used only to group a receiver's history, never as a value
excluded.messageID: dataset bookkeeping identifier, not CAM content; correlated with time
excluded.rcvTime, sendTime (absolute): absolute time identifies the split and the scenario period; only differences are used
excluded.sender.pos, receiver.pos (absolute): absolute location identifies the area (Test is a different area); only distances are used
excluded.sender.hed, receiver.hed (absolute): road orientation proxy for location; only angular differences are used
excluded.sender.distance_to_road_edge: not part of the transmitted message: added after the attacks by Generator/enrichMsgsWithFutherInfo/enrichMsgs.py:158-163 from the REPORTED sender position and the SUMO road map. Computable only by a receiver with the same lane-level map, so it is kept as metadata (road_edge_dist) for an explicitly labelled map-based variant
excluded.*_noise fields: realised sensor error, not a transmitted confidence: the generator recovers the true position as reported - pos_noise (Generator/attackGenerator/attackGenerator.py:179-188); a real receiver cannot know it. Also unmodified by the attacks checked, so any signal would be a sender-selection artefact
excluded.driversProfile: simulation metadata a receiver cannot observe; attack share differs by profile (selection shortcut)
excluded.receiver.acl, receiver.*_noise: receiver-own values not needed by any feature
